title: aidia wallichii
intro: Aidia wallichii, commonly known as the Indian alstonia or Wallich's maidenhair, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is a woody climber or shrub native to the tropical regions of Asia. Aidia wallichii has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, anti-hypertensive, and antioxidant effects.
